posts.subject: knife server
posts.bodyHtml:
hi there its me weedmeister


i had some suggestions for the 35 hp knife server

2. an voice message when the staff joins like server admin joined because it is baddass


3. the final stamm stage shut have join sound aswell a voice message


4. can we please have a weedtrail or a money trail? i would love it


5. if you type !staff then a pop up of the staff


i hope this was helpfull bye bye !

Hi milan! Very nice of you to consider improvements for the 35hp knife server and here are my views on the things you have suggested:


1. Don't think that's possible with the rank plugin. Maybe there's another plugin for it, not sure @Nachtfrische
2. That's a bad idea imo, if there was to say a hacker on the server and it blatantly said 'Admin has joined the server', it would give it away and people will start rule breaking as soon as admin leave.
3. They used to have that but I think it's buggy atm so I'm not too sure, @Sky @BlackFire
4. New !shop items are being developed by @Sky and a recent update has been carried out, maybe he'll make a weed trail just for you on the next update.
5. This again was available but yet again, people will simply rule break as soon as they see that no admins are online.


Thanks,
Doo Doo

I agree with most of what @Doo Doo said, but also going to give more info on some of the things mentioned.


1. Looking for an appropriate I couldn't find any available plugins for that feature. You can try /rankme or /statsme for some other interesting stats though.
2. & 5. What you refer as !staff was already implemented by using !admins. However, as Doo Doo mentioned, it makes people check !admins all the time and start misbehaving faster. New users, who don't know the admins, also start misbehaving faster with this feature.
3. As far as I know, it was removed because it was buggy but maybe it is fixed now? I don't know, we have to try it out.
4. Sky is the only one responsible for the !store and since everything that gets added is made by him, things take a while. Currently he is making some new models that will be added in the next store update.
